VIS-001.rationale: Real Playwright captures every selected route.

VIS-003.rationale: A changed real page returns failed.

VIS-004.rationale: The provider declares three image types and one report.

VIS-005.rationale: The strict manifest and target list support bounded named routes.

VIS-007.rationale: A wrong PNG digest fails before capture.

VIS-008.rationale: Manifest and capability identity must equal the resolved profile.

VIS-009.rationale: The shared strict browser-profile document is required.

VIS-010.rationale: Only selected manifest IDs become capture combinations.

VIS-011.rationale: The real browser version is returned and recorded.

VIS-012.rationale: Capability CSS and screenshot settings disable motion and caret.

VIS-013.rationale: Capture waits for network idle under a deadline.

VIS-014.rationale: Masks are target-scoped, bounded, deduplicated, and returned.

VIS-015.rationale: Real cross-origin traffic and browser side channels are denied.

VIS-016.rationale: Buster owns browser, concurrency, time, byte, and mask limits.

VIS-017.rationale: Only strict-v1 and balanced-v1 are accepted.

VIS-018.rationale: Resolved overrides are stored in report and provider details.

VIS-019.rationale: Uncertain results remain failed without declared review.

VIS-020.rationale: The first provided suite has no agent-review verdict input.

VIS-021.rationale: Provider code writes only attempt evidence.

VIS-022.rationale: Baseline replacement is documented as a separate approval/apply workflow.

VIS-023.rationale: Legacy Discord delivery is deleted and canonical notifications cannot alter verdicts.

VIS-024.rationale: Realpath and repository containment checks reject path escape.

VIS-025.rationale: Abort closes all launched browsers and contexts.

VIS-026.rationale: Typed deployment and public endpoint inputs bind target authority.

VIS-027.rationale: Authenticated vertical execution imports signed evidence and decision.

VIS-DEFECT-028.rationale: No implicit baseline discovery or path compatibility remains.

VIS-DEFECT-029.rationale: Direct screenshot and Discord files are deleted.

VIS-DEFECT-030.rationale: Protocol and runner no longer accept visual-reg.
